pairs.subject: self-describing-data-envelopes
pairs.evidence: src/app/sitemap.ts:13 This context is a set of Next.js metadata-route functions (sitemap, robots, manifest, OG images) that each return a static route list or an ImageResponse; there is no transform pipeline of numeric values whose frame or op history could travel inside the value, and searching the context's directories (and all of src/app) for collate, MetaTensor, applied_operations, torch_function and track_meta found nothing (the only repo-wide 'affine' hits are the French verb in fr.ts locale files)

techniques.evidence: src/app/opengraph-image.tsx:10 OG images return a JSX ImageResponse; no third-party numeric engine type to subclass or wrap
src/app/manifest.ts:7 Static manifest object; no metadata tracking to toggle
src/app/sitemap.ts:35 Builds plain fresh objects per entry; no envelope slots get propagated or copied
src/app/sitemap.ts:17 No binary operations on envelopes; lastModified is computed from git history, not inherited from an operand
src/app/robots.ts:7 No step that stacks items with mismatched metadata keys into a batch
src/app/sitemap.ts:1 'Metadata' here means SEO page metadata, not sibling-key metadata stored next to a value; there is nothing to migrate between the two layouts
